ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Regard the system of inequalities as a planar region: from x+y-3≥0 obtain y≥3-x; from x-y+1≥0 obtain y≤x+1; there is also x≤k. For the upper and lower bounds to have an intersection, 3-x≤x+1 is needed, that is, x≥1, so the feasible region is within 1≤x≤k, and therefore k≥1 is needed. This region is enclosed by the lines y=3-x, y=x+1, and x=k, with vertices being the intersection point of the two oblique lines (1,2), and the intersection points of x=k with the two oblique lines, (k,3-k) and (k,k+1). z=x^2+y^2 represents the square of the distance from the point to the origin, and the maximum value on the closed triangular region can be obtained by comparing the vertices. The z values corresponding to the three vertices are respectively: at (1,2), z=1^2+2^2=5; at (k,3-k), z=k^2+(3-k)^2; at (k,k+1), z=k^2+(k+1)^2. For k≥1, k^2+(k+1)^2 ≥ k^2+(3-k)^2, and k^2+(k+1)^2≥5, so the maximum value comes from (k,k+1). Thus 2k^2+2k+1=13, simplifying gives k^2+k-6=0, that is, (k+3)(k-2)=0, solving gives k=2 or k=-3. Also k≥1, discard -3, hence k=2.

raw_record.question_text: Real numbers $x, y, k$ satisfy $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x+y-3 \geq 0, \\ x-y+1 \geq 0, z=x^{2}+y^{2} \text {, if the maximum value of } z \text { is } 13 \text {, then the value of } k \text { is ( ) } \\ x \leq k,\end{array}\right.$

method.method_draft: 把不等式组看作平面区域。先从题面读出约束：y≥3−x，y≤x+1，x≤k，并由前两条推出必须 x≥1，因此可行区域在 1≤x≤k 内，是由三条边围成的三角形。列出顶点：(1,2)、(k,3−k)、(k,k+1)。因为 z=x^2+y^2 是到原点距离平方，在闭合多边形上的最大值可在顶点处比较。分别算三点的 z 值：5，k^2+(3−k)^2，k^2+(k+1)^2。对 k≥1 比较可知最大值来自 (k,k+1)，所以 2k^2+2k+1=13，解得 k=2 或 −3，再由 k≥1 舍去 −3，得 k=2。
method.CoT_raw: 将不等式组看作平面区域：由 x+y-3≥0 得 y≥3-x；由 x-y+1≥0 得 y≤x+1；还有 x≤k。要使上下界有交集，需 3-x≤x+1，即 x≥1，所以可行区域在 1≤x≤k 内，因此需 k≥1。该区域由直线 y=3-x、y=x+1、x=k 围成，顶点为两斜线交点 (1,2)，以及 x=k 与两条斜线的交点 (k,3-k)、(k,k+1)。z=x^2+y^2 表示点到原点距离的平方，在闭合三角形区域上的最大值可比较顶点处取得。三个顶点对应 z 值分别为：在 (1,2) 处 z=1^2+2^2=5；在 (k,3-k) 处 z=k^2+(3-k)^2；在 (k,k+1) 处 z=k^2+(k+1)^2。对 k≥1，有 k^2+(k+1)^2 ≥ k^2+(3-k)^2，且 k^2+(k+1)^2≥5，所以最大值来自 (k,k+1)。于是 2k^2+2k+1=13，化简得 k^2+k-6=0，即 (k+3)(k-2)=0，解得 k=2 或 k=-3。又 k≥1，舍去 -3，故 k=2。
